sentences.text:
In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in  connection with Chanchal P. S. Case No.862 of 2023 dated  14.07.2023 under Sections 341/323/325/354/376/511/
506/427/435/379/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 (G.R.
 Case No.2064 of 2023).

entities.text: Chanchal P. S. Case No.862 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
In the matter of : Ahebul Sk and others  ... Petitioners  Mr. Mritunjoy Chatterjee,
 Mr. Imdodul Hoque  ... for the petitioners  Mr. Sanjoy Bardhan,
 Ms. Baishakhi Chatterjee  ... for the State  1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. It is submitted at the Bar that the present petitioners are similarly circumstanced with the other co-accused persons who have already been released on anticipatory bail by the co-ordinate Bench vide order dated 4 th August, 2023 in CRM (A) 3213 of 2023.

3. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioners, nature of allegation, ground of parity and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that each of the petitioner shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer in the event of their arrest in the G.R. Case No.2064 of 2023 arising out of the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
4. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
5. Within 21 days from today petitioners are directed to appear before the I.O. along with a server copy or certified copy of this order.
6. The applications being CRM(A) 3674 of 2023 is disposed of.
